title: Host SSH connection reuse
summary: Host control shares a per-host, user and credential OpenSSH master through a private socket under the executing workstation's existing Yoke scratch roots, choosing the short OS temporary scratch root when the configured root is too long for a Unix socket. The master persists for 30 idle seconds. A diagnosed pre-execution stale-socket failure warns host_control_ssh_stale_socket and OpenSSH falls back to a fresh connection before execution; the transport never replays remote commands, including exit 255 after native fallback. Socket setup failures name host_control_ssh_socket_unavailable and ask for a short writable temp_root. Source behavior awaits live timing proof.
